places.name: Pattaya Beach
places.ai_summary: A bustling beach offering water sports, sunbathing, and a vibrant nightlife scene.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring sunscreen and enjoy water sports like jet skiing.

attribution.title: Jomtien Beach 1
attribution.author: Pescov
attribution.description: Jomtien Beach, near soi Welcome Jomtien

places.name: Walking Street
places.ai_summary: A vibrant street known for its nightlife, featuring bars, clubs, and live entertainment.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited after 8:00 PM for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Be cautious of your belongings in crowded areas.

places.name: Sanctuary of Truth
places.ai_summary: A magnificent wooden structure showcasing intricate carvings that reflect Thai culture and spirituality.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available at the entrance.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes as the site is expansive.

places.name: Nong Nooch Tropical Garden
places.ai_summary: A sprawling garden paradise showcasing Thailand's flora, fauna, and cultural performances.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for cultural performance timings.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the elephant show and traditional Thai dance performances.
places.address: Nong Nooch Tropical Garden, Pattaya, Thailand

places.name: Jomtien Beach
places.ai_summary: A serene beach destination ideal for relaxation, water sports, and enjoying sunsets.

opening_hours.notes: Less crowded in the early morning.

places.place_tip: Try local seafood at beachside restaurants.

attribution.title: Jomtien Beach 1
attribution.author: Pescov
attribution.description: Jomtien Beach, near soi Welcome Jomtien

places.name: Pattaya Floating Market
places.ai_summary: A lively market featuring local handicrafts, food, and cultural performances, all set on water.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon to evening.

places.place_tip: Bargain for souvenirs and try local delicacies.

attribution.title: Jukung Pasar Terapung
attribution.author: Muhammad Haris
attribution.description: Pasar terapung is a culture of the city of a thousand rivers, Banjarmasin. The uniqueness of transactions in pasar terapung is a reflection of the culture of the people of Banjar. Until now the pasar terapung Lok Baintan, at Banjar district is still as the main attraction of South Kalimantan's trade and tourism activities

places.name: Art in Paradise
places.ai_summary: An interactive 3D art museum where visitors become part of the artwork.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 8:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Great for photos; interact with the 3D art installations.

places.name: Pattaya Viewpoint (Khao Pattaya Viewpoint)
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint offering panoramic views of Pattaya city and bay, especially beautiful at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon or early evening.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos of the cityscape.

places.name: Coral Island (Koh Larn)
places.ai_summary: A nearby island known for its crystal-clear waters, coral reefs, and water sports activities.

opening_hours.notes: Ferries operate every hour; last ferry at 5:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Snorkeling gear is available for rent on the island.

places.name: Tiffany’s Cabaret Show
places.ai_summary: A world-famous cabaret show featuring stunning performances by transgender artists.

opening_hours.notes: Book tickets in advance to secure good seats.

places.place_tip: Arrive early for the best seating options.

places.name: Pattaya Park Tower
places.ai_summary: A tower offering panoramic views of Pattaya from its observation deck, with a revolving restaurant.

opening_hours.notes: Last elevator up at 9:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Visit during sunset for a breathtaking view.

places.name: Mini Siam
places.ai_summary: A miniature park featuring replicas of Thailand's famous landmarks and structures.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Great for photos; consider a visit to the nearby Siam Cultural Park.

places.name: Big Buddha Hill (Wat Phra Yai)
places.ai_summary: A hilltop temple featuring a giant Buddha statue and offering panoramic views of Pattaya.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Dress respectfully as it is a religious site.

attribution.title: Khao Chi Chan in Amphoe Sattahip
attribution.author: Niceley
attribution.description: Khao Chi Chan in Amphoe Sattahip.

places.name: Underwater World Pattaya
places.ai_summary: An ocean-themed park featuring a variety of marine life, underwater tunnels, and interactive exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 5:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Check out the feeding sessions for an interactive experience.

attribution.title: Koh Tarutao, Thailand, Rocky beach
attribution.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
attribution.description: The infinity and eternity of Koh Tarutao (Island), Satun, Thailand. The mysterious Tarutao Island is of ancient Cambrian (550 million years) and Ordovician (450 million years) origin. There are very, very few places like this on planet Earth.

places.name: Ripley’s Believe It or Not!
places.ai_summary: A quirky museum featuring oddities and exhibits that challenge the imagination.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 9:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Great for families; interactive exhibits are a highlight.
places.address: Ripley’s Believe It or Not!, Pattaya, Thailand

places.name: Central Festival Pattaya Beach Mall
places.ai_summary: A large shopping mall featuring a variety of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options.

opening_hours.notes: Check for individual store hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop for a great view of the beach.
places.address: Central Festival Pattaya Beach Mall, Pattaya, Thailand

places.name: Pattaya Dolphinarium
places.ai_summary: A marine park featuring dolphin shows, sea lion performances, and interactive experiences.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for show timings.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for better rates.

places.name: Million Years Stone Park & Crocodile Farm
places.ai_summary: A unique park featuring stone sculptures, crocodile shows, and a variety of other animals.
places.name_english: Million Years Stone Park & Crocodile Farm

opening_hours.notes: Crocodile shows are at scheduled times.

places.place_tip: Watch out for the feeding shows; they are quite popular.
places.address: Million Years Stone Park & Crocodile Farm, Pattaya, Thailand

attribution.author: MartinRe at English Wikipedia

places.name: Thepprasit Night Market
places.ai_summary: A bustling night market offering a variety of street food, clothes, and souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the full night market experience.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food and shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Pattaya City Sign Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint and photo spot featuring the iconic 'Pattaya City' sign with the city and sea in the background.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: A great spot for panoramic photos of Pattaya.
places.address: Pattaya City Sign Viewpoint, Pattaya, Thailand
